class.name: normalized_known_warp_two_exponential
class.noise: independent standard normal per observation; latent not observed

design.rng: numpy SeedSequence([seed,round(10000*delta)]); first coefficients, then observations in action order

primary.metric: mean squared error on original synthetic response scale
primary.baseline: lowest development contrast MSE among feasible controls; selection frozen before test
primary.required_improvement: at least 10% relative MSE improvement separately at both deltas; no pooled-only success
primary.paired_uncertainty: future paired Student-t 95% interval for mean loss difference over eight independent test experiments per delta; descriptive approximate interval, not finite-sample certified coverage
primary.practical_limit: This is a small falsification pilot, not a powered confirmation; no post-outcome seed extension. Identical minimum-distance control defeats novelty regardless of nominal interval.

secondary: coverage/width only if a separately specified interval is evaluated

methods.status: mathematically identical mandatory control; no separate algorithmic advantage possible

intervals.available_control: conservative DKW-plus-known-inverse bound; full parameter-range bound when central quantile condition fails

stops: current exact equivalence to bilinear/minimum-distance control: no novelty or pilot request
any missing fitting authorization: do not execute
do not change target, sample count, delta regimes, seeds or controls after outcomes
nonfinite objectives or cap hit: retain failure and stop, no tuned rerun
failed known-information or hidden-label check: invalidate comparison
unknown-profile claim without source learner and nuisance-error theorem: stop

prospective_cost.quantile_algorithm: O(n log n) per action; constant-size solves; no iterative training
prospective_cost.derivation: 20 experiments * 200 objective calls * 2 parameter-dependent actions * 128 observations; gradient/line-search counts must be included within maxfun; limit semantics need validation
prospective_cost.reason_no_numeric_total: No fitted run or benchmark authorized. Current complete four-delta diagnostic is not a valid estimate for convergence, line-search or network runtime; inverse-call timing and all optimizer overhead remain unmeasured. No complete pilot cap requested.

data: synthetic only; no siRNA efficacy or GNN validation
